items.title: Why predictive maintenance matters more as factories add robots
items.summary: Robot data combined with predictive analytics can improve uptime and productivity, says ATS. Source: Pexels, Advanced Technology Services Factories are adding more robots because they can handle repetitive, precise, and physically demanding work at high speed. As robotics take on a greater share of production, keeping those systems available becomes more important. The International Federation of Robotics ( IFR ) reported about 5 million industrial robots in operation worldwide in 2025, up 11% from the prior year. An unexpected robot failure can affect more than one machine. It can interrupt a cell, slow a line, and create delays that spread through the plant. As manufacturers rely more heavily on robotic systems, the need to identify developing problems before they force equipment offline becomes increasingly valuable.
